title: How long is a 50 m² floor?
hook: A square floor covers 50 square metres. How long is each wall?

knows: area of a square as side × side, in square metres
doesNotKnow: the square root as the side that gives an area, and that it need not be a whole number

misconception: The square root of 50 is 25 (halving), or it must be a whole number.
objective: The learner can bracket √50 between 7 (49) and 8 (64), refine it to about 7.07, and say that a square root is the side of a square with that area.

claims.text: A square's area is side × side: 5 × 5 = 25, 10 × 10 = 100 and 25 × 25 = 625 square metres.
claims.source: Area of a square = s². Demo.tsx area(x) = x × x rounded to 2 decimals; node recomputed.

claims.text: 7 × 7 = 49 and 8 × 8 = 64, so a 50 m² square has a side between 7 m and 8 m, and no whole number squared is 50.
claims.source: 7² = 49 < 50 < 64 = 8²; squares of whole numbers increase, so none lies strictly between 49 and 64.

claims.text: The square root of 50 is the side whose square is 50: about 7.07 m, not a whole number.
claims.source: Definition of the principal square root; node Math.sqrt(50) = 7.0711 (Demo.tsx ROOT). The dashed outline is drawn at side ROOT. | REVISION v2 2026-10-14: text edited to match stage; needs re-check.

claims.text: Halving 50 does not find the side: a 25 m side gives 625 m², 12.5 times the 50 m² target.
claims.source: 25² = 625 ≠ 50. | REVISION v2 2026-10-14: text edited to match stage; needs re-check.

claims.text: Nor does dividing by 4: 12.5 m gave 156.25 m² (12.5 × 12.5), about 3.1× the 50 m² target.
claims.source: Arithmetic: 12.5 × 12.5 = 156.25; 156.25 / 50 = 3.125, shown on stage as '3.1× the target' by the existing verdict code. Added because 12.5 m (50 ÷ 4) is now a predict option and a side chip (r5 minor: the decoy 'about 12 m'). | REVISED v3 2026-10-14 (demo-builder, wave D r5): new sentence. New reveal sentence and new chip. | FACT-CHECK 2026-10-14 (pass 22): area(12.5) = 156.25; 156.25 / 50 = 3.125, toFixed(1) = '3.1' (checked in node); caption '(3.1× the target)'; reveal sentence prints area(TARGET / 4).

recall.question: A square garden has area 30 m². Its side is...
recall.why: 5 × 5 = 25 and 6 × 6 = 36, so the side (√30, about 5.48 m) lies between them.
